purpose: Freeze a falsifiable holdout protocol that turns the v0.5.0 post-hoc differential dissipative-susceptibility hypothesis into a prospective prediction.

pair_universe.source: All 66 certified ordered path pairs from the v0.5.0 exact-root/open-system source artifacts.
pair_universe.notation: i>j denotes that certified path i is better than path j in the frozen unitary exact-root ordering.
pair_universe.diagnostic_pair_policy: Named diagnostic pairs are reported explicitly but do not determine PASS or FAIL.

training_data_policy.source: Use only v1.0 already public small-perturbation points.

formulas.slope_fit: For each channel, fit D_ij(lambda) on lambda in {0, 1e-4, 3e-4} using the declared least-squares linear model D_ij(lambda)=a_ij + chi_ij lambda; Delta_ij is D_ij(0) from the public unitary point.
formulas.positive_crossing_rule: Predict a positive-axis crossing only when chi_ij < 0 and lambda_pred_ij > 0; otherwise label no-crossing-on-positive-axis.
formulas.actual_first_flip_scale: The first holdout lambda at which the pair direction differs from the lambda=0 frozen direction, evaluated separately for decay, dephasing, and the declared joint diagonal grid.

classification_rules.pair_direction_accuracy_denominator: All certified ordered pairs across all held-out single-channel and joint conditions.
classification_rules.harrell_c_index_denominator: Comparable pair-pair examples with observed first-flip order and finite predicted positive scales; censored no-flip cases are reported and handled according to the released analysis script, not silently dropped.
classification_rules.factor_of_two_rule: A positive prediction is within factor two when 0.5 * actual_first_flip_lambda <= lambda_pred <= 2.0 * actual_first_flip_lambda.
classification_rules.failure_reporting: Every failed gate, every no-crossing label, every observed flip, and every diagnostic pair result must be reported.

solver_environment.equation: QuTiP Lindblad/GKSL density-matrix propagation matching open-system v1.0

non_claims: This protocol does not run or reveal holdout results.
This protocol does not modify Arb/Krawczyk proof engines, exact-root boxes, or earlier certificates.
This protocol is not an Arb interval proof.
This protocol is not calibrated PASQAL hardware noise and is not PASQAL Cloud, FRESNEL, or QPU evidence.
The differential dissipative-susceptibility mechanism remains a post-hoc v1.1 hypothesis until this frozen holdout protocol is executed.

canonicalization.hash_exclusion: The canonical_protocol_sha256 field is removed before hashing.
